rationale: FX02 flagged fair_value_currency value U_USD as not USD, but the raw investment schedule presents the affected Fair Value column in dollars. Table 5 and table 6 both label the column Fair Value and show dollar signs on detail/total fair value cells. U_USD is therefore a USD-denominated unit label rather than evidence of a non-USD fair value currency; the rule is over-scoped to the literal unit token.
